name: logo
label: Logo (White Version)
help_text: Upload the white logo SVG/PNG. Displayed in the top-left of the header.

name: logo_url
label: Logo Link
help_text: Optional. Where the logo links to when clicked (typically the dashboard or homepage).

name: greeting_prefix
label: Greeting Prefix
help_text: Word shown before the time of day. Default: "Good" → renders as "Good Morning, [Member]"

name: subtitle
label: Subtitle Text
help_text: Line shown beneath the greeting in the header.
default: Here's an overview of your membership activity

name: hamburger_icon
label: Hamburger Menu Icon (Mobile)
help_text: Icon shown on mobile to open the navigation sidebar. Upload SVG/PNG OR paste SVG code.

children.name: image
children.label: Upload Icon (SVG or PNG)
children.help_text: Upload from Files Manager. Recommended: 24×24px SVG.

children.name: svg_code
children.label: Or: Paste SVG Code
children.help_text: Paste the raw <svg>...</svg> code for the hamburger/menu icon.

children.name: gradient_start
children.label: Gradient Start Color
children.help_text: Top-left color of the header gradient. Default: black.

children.name: gradient_end
children.label: Gradient End Color
children.help_text: Bottom-right color of the header gradient. Default: VIPS red.

children.name: text_color
children.label: Text Color
children.help_text: Override the default text color for this module instance. Leave empty for theme default.

children.name: content_width
children.label: Content Width
children.help_text: Control the maximum width of this module's content.

children.name: hide_on_desktop
children.label: Hide on Desktop
children.help_text: Toggle to hide this module on desktop viewports.
